abort.no_devices_found: No Hunter Douglas Bliss blinds could be found. Make sure they are powered and in range, then try again.
abort.not_supported: This device is not a supported Hunter Douglas Bliss motor.

user.title: Bliss Blinds
user.description:
Select the Hunter Douglas Bliss motor to add.

Only motors discovered as `HDxxxx` are shown — the Bluetooth name is the motor model.

blind_type.title: Pick the blind type
blind_type.description:
Detected motor **{model}** named **{name}** ({serial_number}).

The motor doesn't tell the app which kind of blind it is — this is the type you picked when pairing it in the Bliss app.

init.title: Bliss Blinds options
init.description: Correct the blind type if it was set wrong, or adjust the ShangriLa tilt-open fraction (0 = default).
